title: Partial observability and Bayesian belief states

chapters.text: Start with an uncertain belief. Posterior belief: 0.5; Belief entropy: 0.693.
Add one observation. Posterior belief: 0.7; Belief entropy: 0.611.
Update posterior odds. Posterior belief: 0.845; Belief entropy: 0.432.
Accumulate independent evidence. Posterior belief: 0.927; Belief entropy: 0.261.
Inspect residual uncertainty. Posterior belief: 0.967; Belief entropy: 0.144.
